item.title: [threat-intel] UNC4899 Breached Crypto Firm After Developer AirDropped Trojanized File to Work Device
item.description: The North Korean threat actor known as UNC4899 is suspected to be behind a sophisticated cloud compromise campaign targeting a cryptocurrency organization in 2025 to steal millions of dollars in cryptocurrency. item.title: [threat-intel] Chinese Cyber Threat Lurks In Critical Asian Sectors for Years
item.description: An undefined Chinese-speaking actor wields a combo of custom malware, open source tools, and LOTL binaries against Windows and Linux, likely for spying.

item.title: [threat-intel] Russia-linked hackers target Signal, WhatsApp of officials globally
item.description: Russia-linked hackers are targeting Signal and WhatsApp accounts of government and military officials worldwide, warns Dutch intelligence. Dutch intelligence agencies (MIVD and AIVD) warn of a global campaign by Russia-linked threat actors aiming to compromise Signal and WhatsApp accounts. item.title: [threat-intel] Tentacles of ‘0ktapus’ Threat Group Victimize 130 Firms
item.description: Over 130 companies tangled in sprawling phishing campaign that spoofed a multi-factor authentication system.

item.title: [threat-intel] This spy tool has been quietly stealing data for years
item.description: <p>ESET researchers have traced the resurgence of Sednit through a modern toolkit built around two complementary implants, BeardShell and Covenant, each relying on a separate cloud provider to ensure operational resilience. This dual-implant architecture has enabled sustained surveillance of Ukrainian military personnel since at least April 2024.
